title: Every game of our murder mystery makes a new crime film. Over 100 trillion possible ones. Every game of our murder mystery makes a new crime film. Over 100 trillion possible ones. Built for game nights.
author: virtualbudz
selftext:
If you've played Clue, Deception: Murder in Hong Kong and Secret Hitler, you already get the idea. Solve a murder like Clue, follow a silent witness's hints like Deception, and never trust the person next to you, like Secret Hitler. Then we added the TV films.  
  
Every game ends up with its own little crime film. The clues change each round, the paintings change, and by our count there are over 100 trillion different films it can make.

How it plays (one room, 6 to 16 people)

* Everyone joins with their phone. The phone is your secret hand of cards. The TV is the crime board.
* At night the Killer secretly picks how it was done: one TOOL and one TRACE from their own cards. Say a Poisoned Martini and a Lipstick Napkin.
* The Psychic sees the answer but can't speak. They can only drop markers on clue cards: Poisoned, At Home, Last Call, Festive...
* Those clues become a vision: a short haunted film on the TV, built from the clues, different every time.
* Everyone argues, pins theories, and someone files a warrant: suspect, TOOL and TRACE. Get all three right and the Killer goes to jail. But from the cell they get one phone call.

**Other ways to play:** in Ghost mode there's no Psychic. The Killer strikes each night and the dead come back as

ghosts who give clues about their own murder. The Witness saw who did it but has to hint without getting caught.

More roles: the Fixer, the Mole, the Bodyguard, the Forger.

The numbers

* 18.4 billion possible clue boards
* Over 100 trillion possible films
* 1,039 paintings, 230 evidence cards, 10 characters with about 18 pictures each

No film repeated across a whole test night of 8 games

How it was made: one Claude (Fable 5.2) ran the whole build: it planned, directed coding helpers, and directed five

GPT image sessions in Codex that painted all the art from one shared to-do list and a log, each picking up the next job (codex still doesn't do gif and new gpt image 2.6 I think, I was not able to do it) on its own. Full write-up with the fails, the method and a template you can copy: [https://claude.ai/artifact/S2XiViThAbYms5a9cSt6zF](https://claude.ai/artifact/S2XiViThAbYms5a9cSt6zF)

Built for our family game night. Happy to answer anything about the game or the build.

Play it: [https://play.virtualcarry.com](https://play.virtualcarry.com) (works best with a TV and 6+ phones)
